name: vault-capture
description: Turn a typed or spoken braindump into schema-valid notes in an Obsidian vault inbox, marked as model-written and keeping the braindump verbatim.

tools.name: vault_capture
tools.description: Split a braindump into its distinct notes, draft each one as prose in the vault owner's own voice, write schema-valid frontmatter with a forced 'capture_type: generated', and create the notes in '00 Inbox' while keeping the braindump verbatim under a '# Braindump' heading; also proposes approval-gated edits to the vault's voice-and-style note from style feedback. Creates new files only and is inspectable with status/doctor.
